description: You are a Java developer modernising a legacy HR system. The project at /home/ga/legacy-hr-system was written for Java 8 and uses outdated APIs throughout. Import the project into Eclipse. Your task is to modernise it to Java 17 by: (1) Replacing ALL java.util.Date and java.util.Calendar usages with the java.time API (LocalDate, LocalDateTime, Period, DateTimeFormatter) — this affects Employee.java, PayrollCalculator.java, ReportGenerator.java, and HrApplication.java; (2) Adding proper generic type parameters to ALL raw-type collections (List, Map, ArrayList, HashMap) in EmployeeDirectory.java, PayrollCalculator.java, and ReportGenerator.java; (3) Replacing ALL StringBuffer usages with StringBuilder in EmployeeDirectory.java and ReportGenerator.java; (4) Updating the Maven compiler source and target in pom.xml from 8 to 17. After all changes, run 'mvn clean test' to confirm all tests pass with the modernised code.

metadata.legacy_1: java.util.Date/Calendar in Employee.java, PayrollCalculator.java, ReportGenerator.java, HrApplication.java
metadata.legacy_2: Raw type List/Map in EmployeeDirectory.java, PayrollCalculator.java, ReportGenerator.java
metadata.legacy_4: pom.xml compiler source/target set to 8 instead of 17
